notes_for_editor: NO STORY WRITTEN (held). The only lookout-specific readable source is the Canada Lookouts index entry, which places Copton Ridge under the Grande Prairie Division (cite 1). Cites 2 and 3 are system-wide context. TWO ARCHIVE LEADS CONFLICT AND MUST BE CHECKED BY HAND BEFORE USE. Both were seen only as search snippets, because the pages were blocked (a Cloudflare challenge at albertaonrecord.ca) or redirected with no text (searchprovincialarchives.alberta.ca). (a) Alberta On Record, 'Copton Lookout' (albertaonrecord.ca/is-gpr-1306733): the snippet reads 'Dave Schenk at the Copton Lookout site --closed down in 1959.' (b) Provincial Archives of Alberta file PR1968.0181/1: 'Visitor's register/notebook, kept at Copton Ridge fire tower, 1961-68', which implies use after 1959. These cannot be cited until a readable copy is found. PROTECTED DATA: the record's built year (1955), height (5 m), elevation, exact coordinates, access and staffing come only from the Alberta WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT layer. Its metadata (data/raw/expansion/prairies-north/ab_lookout_layer0_meta.json) marks the layer Protected, not for display on maps at 1:1,000,000 or larger or on maps with local roads seen by the public. None of those values is used here. No public source supports the 1955 build year. Not the same tower: the 2024 Grande Prairie Museum tower (TheRegional, 14 Oct 2024; CTV, 10 Oct 2024) was a college training tower moved from the Grande Prairie Alberta Forestry offices. It is not named Copton and was not used. Searches used: 2 (websearch.py).
